==Locations==
*[[Vabbi]]

==Dialogue==
:''"Can I see your [[weapon]]? Oooh. It's better than mine. You want to [[trade]]? Is it [[customized]]? Did you find it in [[Vabbi]]? You find the best stuff in Vabbi. I need a better weapon to advance in the arena. that's what's wrong: my bad equipment"'' {{sic}}

==Quotes==
:''"Didn't we fight once? In the arena? I'm sure I remember your name."''
:''"You know why [[monk]]s are always skulking around in the back? Because they're sneaky. I don't trust 'em back there. I don't trust 'em at all."''

==Trivia==
*Mikahl Hintohn is named after an Alpha tester.
